purpose: implementation design, no generated assets included

coordinates.units: one visual unit is one game tile; no historical or physical real-world scale claim
coordinates.rigged_asset_post_rig_adapter: rotate entire rig root by pi around Y once, then validate all clips

reuse_rules.players: one rig and base texture, six per-instance team material tints and numbered ground markers
reuse_rules.extractors: one geometry, four source icon/material variants
reuse_rules.mk2: same geometry, static upgrade badge and restrained material accent
reuse_rules.items: 14 distinct UI icons; common cargo pod geometry carries icon and quantity, no 14 separate Meshy models
reuse_rules.ground_roads_markers_ui: procedural geometry and vector UI; not Meshy-generated
reuse_rules.sources: six shallow tray instances per source zone, no new solid footprint
reuse_rules.carried_pod: one pod per nonempty player inventory; active selected nonempty slot icon, else lowest numbered nonempty slot; logical inventory remains up to four slots

START.note: procedural workzone only; fixed server footprint exists

M2.note: gantry stays on ground during launch

M6.note: seven additional panels, total eight; fuel badge state changes without extra fuel debit

rocket_assembly_contract.join_policy: offline alignment and attachment verification; bounds and join faces are not guaranteed by generation prompts
rocket_assembly_contract.partial_build: server assembly progress reveals a fixed ordered list of existing submeshes, never rescale the entire rocket
rocket_assembly_contract.launch: ground roots remain; flight root moves only after durable launch result; camera contract owns framing

assets.bounds_measurement_pose: neutral A-pose; animation culling bounds measured separately
